Turn Python or YAML data into sortable tables, interactive theme-aware charts, KPI metrics, progress bars, and structured key-value views.

Python builder YAML type What it renders aiui.metric(label, *, value, delta, delta_color, caption, sparkline, benchmark, benchmark_label) metric KPI tile with colored delta, inline trend sparkline, and benchmark comparison aiui.stat_group(stats) stat_group Compact multi-metric strip aiui.table(data=None, *, headers, rows, columns, searchable, sortable, page_size, row_detail, ...) table Full data table (accepts pandas/Polars DataFrames, dict lists, or headers+rows): typed columns (number, badge, tag, link, date, progress, image, sparkline), search, sort, paging, and row detail drawer aiui.sheet(title, *, headers, rows, tabs, id, action, save_label) sheet Interactive multi-tab spreadsheet with live cell editing, zero-eval formulas (=SUM, =AVERAGE, =IF), row filter, CSV/JSON export, and optional action= Save callback to Python aiui.whiteboard(items, *, title, id) whiteboard Interactive whiteboard canvas with draggable stickies/shapes, live arrow tracking, + Sticky, zoom, fullscreen, and SVG/JSON export aiui.chart(title, *, data, chart_type, x, y, y2, stacked, reference, facet, ...) chart Lazy-loaded Recharts chart (accepts dict lists or pandas/Polars DataFrames): bar, barh, line, area, scatter, pie, donut, histogram, heatmap, sparkline, plus facet small multiples aiui.plotly_chart(fig, title="", *, height, caption) chart Converts standard Plotly figures (bar, line, area, scatter, pie/donut, histogram, heatmap) into native Recharts chart blocks without bundling plotly.js aiui.badge(text, *, variant) badge Status pill (default, secondary, destructive, outline) aiui.caption(text) caption Muted helper or footnote line aiui.progress_bar(label, *, value, max_value=100) progress_bar Labeled progress indicator aiui.key_value_list(items, *, title) key_value_list Clean two-column key/value table aiui.definition_list(items, *, title) definition_list Structured label/value definition list aiui.code_block(code, *, language) code_block Syntax-highlighted code with copy button aiui.diff_viewer(before, after, *, title, before_label, after_label) diff_viewer Line-by-line unified diff viewer for prompts, configs and generated code aiui.copy_field(value, *, label, secret=False) copy_field Copyable command, URL or API key box with optional secret reveal toggle aiui.json_view(data, *, title, collapsed) json_view Collapsible JSON inspector aiui.avatar(*, src, name, fallback, size) avatar User or agent avatar image/initials
